sections.Profile:
Dirty Harry, released by Williams in March 1995 and designed by Barry Oursler, is a four-player licensed game drawn from Clint Eastwood's Dirty Harry film series. It runs on Williams' WPC Security hardware with a dot-matrix display and three flippers, and Eastwood recorded its speech calls himself.
